verdict.rationale: The evidence shows vLLM has a CLI that starts the OpenAI-compatible server (vllm-docs-27) and accepts model-loading flags such as --trust-remote-code (vllm-docs-25), so loading a model from the command line is supported. However, nothing in the pack documents flags for GPU offload or context length. Missing for 10: documented CLI flags for GPU/CPU offload or GPU memory control, documented context-length (max model length) flag, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
